review.reason: The diff introduces bounded capability: it establishes a reusable access-control mixin and enforces channel-bound creation for sandbox-generated canvases. This changes authorization behavior and could prevent an unauthenticated or mismatched request from creating resources. However, no broader systemic risk reduction or wider component dependency is demonstrated across multiple critical paths, so tier 3 is unsupported. Tier 1 is too narrow because the change adds shared enforcement rather than local maintenance.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog’s Canvas product and its integration with Task Sandboxes and OAuth. It could help users avoid placing agent-built apps outside their intended workspace, but adoption and benefit cannot be inferred from code alone.
review.uncertainty: Changes depend on SANDBOX_OAUTH_APP_CLIENT_IDS and tasks_facade implementations not shown. Compatibility with existing clients and edge cases around anonymous/service principals is not demonstrated.
